# cancom_iam_service_user_session (Resource)

Ephemeral session token for a service user with automatic re-roll support.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cancom_iam_service_user_session" "session" {
  service_user_crn = cancom_iam_service_user.su.principal
  comment      = "CI/CD ephemeral runner session"
  reroll_days  = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_user_crn` (String) Principal CRN of the service user (e.g. `crn:cancom::iam:serviceuser:testuser2`).

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment / description for the session.
- `reroll_days` (Number) Number of days before expiration to trigger a recreation (reroll) of the session token. Defaults to `0`.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the session is currently enabled.
- `expires_at` (Number) The expiration timestamp (UNIX epoch in seconds) of the session token.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jwt` (String, Sensitive) The JWT session token.
- `last_issued_at` (String) Timestamp when the session was last issued.
- `session_id` (String) The session ID extracted from the token / API.
- `ttl` (String) TTL timestamp of the session.
